---
title: "Learning to Code in R with Generative AI - Common Theme Associations"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
### SETUP AND DATA LOADING

library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(tidytext)
library(forcats)

# Load the survey data
survey_data <- read_csv("Comment_Theme_Associations_Full.csv")

# View the first few rows
head(survey_data)

### SUMMARY TABLE 1: OVERALL THEME FREQUENCY BY SECTION

theme_by_section <- survey_data |>
  filter(Substantive == "Yes") |>
  select(Section, Theme_1, Theme_2, Theme_3) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Theme_"),
    names_to = "theme_position",
    values_to = "theme"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(theme) & theme != "Excluded" & theme != "") |>
  group_by(Section, theme) |>
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(Section) |>
  mutate(
    percent = count / sum(count)
  ) |>
  ungroup() 

print(theme_by_section)
```


### VISUALIZATION: BAR PLOT OF THEMES BY SECTION COUNT

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 12
theme_by_section |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(theme, count), y = count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#881c1c") +
  facet_wrap(~Section, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top Themes by Course Section",
       x = "Theme",
       y = "Frequency",
       fill = "Section") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1))

# ggsave("theme_distribution_by_section_count.png", width = 6, height = 8)
```

### VISUALIZATION: BAR PLOT OF THEMES BY SECTION PERCENT

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 12

theme_by_section |>
  filter(count > 0) |>
  mutate(
    theme_section = fct_reorder(
      interaction(theme, Section, sep = "___"),
      percent
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = theme_section, y = percent)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#881c1c") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::percent(percent, accuracy = 1)),
    hjust = -0.05,            # push text past bar end
    size = 3
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ Section, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("___.*$", "", x)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percent of responses",
    title = "Theme distribution by section"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(color = "black"), axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1))
```
